Subject: Symmetry Solutions — co-sell demo slotting & fallback routing

John / Amy —

Thanks for the quick intro last week. Symmetry x Redwood x AWS looks like a clean co-sell motion; we'd like to lock a demo window so the SI can show the end-to-end flow and we can confirm the marketplace listing experience. Proposed primary slots (60 min, include 15 min Q&A + 10 min marketplace console walkthrough):

- Tue, 15 Sep 2026 — 10:00–11:00 PT (preferred)
- Wed, 16 Sep 2026 — 14:00–15:00 PT (backup)

Quick agenda (attached):
- 0–10: intro & GTM roles (Vanessa / Amy / John)
- 10–35: Symmetry demo: integration & architecture deep-dive
- 35–50: Marketplace listing walkthrough (Amy)
- 50–60: Next steps & ask items

As part of planning, can you confirm: who from Symmetry will present (product vs. engineering)? If your engineer might be on travel, please nominate a backup presenter. Also confirm whether BrightLine (customer reference) will join — Nilesh is copied for scheduling.

Attachments: symmetry-demo-agenda.pdf (pdf)

If both slots work we can post a calendar invite; we recommend the 15 Sep slot so Redwood can include a short pre-demo run with our SE (Karthik) 30 minutes before the public demo.

—Vanessa Ortiz

Thanks Vanessa — those windows look good. Quick notes from our side:

- Symmetry will present with our Head of Product, Mira Chen, as primary; our lead integration engineer (Rahul Mehta) is travelling 9/15–9/17 but can do remote if needed.
- Preferred slot: 15 Sep 10:00 PT works but if Rahul is needed for a live demo he prefers 16 Sep 14:00 PT.
- Backup presenters: Mira can cover high-level flow; Rahul can pre-record a 6–8 minute segment of the infra walkthrough if live video/audio is unreliable.

I've attached a short brief and a topology diagram. Also tagging Nilesh as the customer contact — he confirmed interest in a 9/15 demo but asked for a 10:00 PT start.

Vanessa / Sergio —

If we lock 9/15 10:00 PT here's a quick operations plan from the SE side:

- 09:30 PT: Redwood pre-demo (Karthik + Symmetry engineer if available) — verify token scopes, model routing, and any firewall/VPC access for the demo subset.
- 10:00 PT: Public demo starts. Karthik to open with a 5-minute Redwood runtime primer (how routing and fallback will work).
- Fallback rules: if Symmetry engineer (Rahul) drops or can't demonstrate live infra, Karthik takes over infra demo using a canned demo artifact (we should run it once during the pre-demo).

Action items I can take: run a 30-min rehearsal with Rahul (or Mira if Rahul unavailable) the morning of 9/15, and prep a short pre-record (~7 min) of the infra path.

Let me know if Laura should own the customer-facing recording and post the artifact to the shared Drive.

—Karthik
